name: Rascalz
description: '''Rascalz''' are a [[Canadians|Canadian]] [[hip hop music|hip-hop]] group from [[Vancouver]], [[British Columbia]]. The group played a crucial role in the artistic and commercial development of [[Canadian hip hop]] as well as specifically for the west coast scene in Vancouver popularizing the term "Van City". The group consists of [[Master of Ceremonies|emcees]] Red1 and Misfit, and [[record producer]] DJ Kemo. [[Breakdance]]rs Zebroc and Dedos were also part of the group.
